cases.name: Aundria Lynn Eberhart Crawford
cases.about:
She was a student at Cuesta College who lived
in San Luis Obispo.

"She enjoyed monster trucks and ballet and insisted on driving wherever she went so she was never too far from her car. She enjoyed throwing parties, and was admired by a friend for not drinking while she played host. She let herself fall behind during high school but caught up again with the help of a home-study program. She showed an interest in architecture and interior design but, like many people her age, had yet to settle on a career. Some thought her love of horses might steer her toward vet school and weren't surprised when she abruptly quit her job at Kragen to go to The Equine Center."

https://mcali.tripod.com/aundria.html
cases.narrative: The morning of March 11, 1999 he scaled up to a tiny 2 ft by 8 inch bathroom window ten feet off the ground and squeezed himself through that window. It took the investigating officers a week to figure out how he got in. All her other doors and windows were locked. He kidnapped, raped, sodomized, tortured and strangled her to death. Her body was discovered in a shallow grave on the property of an isolated home he rented in the Avila Valley. She had been able to escape his house, only to be chased down and strangled to death by Krebs. He wrapped her in chicken wire and buried her in a 4-foot-deep grave just 20 feet from the house’s back door.

cases.name: Rachel Lindsay Newhouse
cases.about: She was a student at the California Polytechnic State University in San Luis Obispo, California, where she majored in nutritional science.
cases.narrative: On 4/23/1999, her body was discovered in a shallow grave on the property of an isolated home he rented in the Avila Valley. After she disappeared in 1998, her blood was found on a bridge she would have traveled over to get home. He abducted her while wearing a "Scream" mask and took her to his secluded home. He hogtied her and left her to strangle to death.
